verdict.rationale: Baseten's Model APIs pricing docs state you can set a workspace budget alongside usage attribution by API key, user, model, or service tier, so a budget control exists. The docs do not say whether the budget is a hard cap that stops spend or only an alert, and they place it only in the Model APIs context, not dedicated deployments or training jobs. Missing for 10: confirmation of hard-cap enforcement versus alerting behavior, alert or notification mechanics, coverage for dedicated GPU deployments and training jobs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can set spending caps or budget alerts so a runaway workload cannot generate an unbounded bill

citations.quote: You can set a workspace budget, inspect token usage, and attribute costs by API key, user, model, or service tier.
Model APIs bill by token and enforce request and token rate limits. You can also set a workspace budget and query usage by API key or model.
